# no-multiple-blank-lines

- ID: `MD012`
- Category: Whitespace and layout
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `whitespace`, `blank_lines`
- Also named: `no-multiple-blanks`, as in markdownlint

Outside code, no two blank lines follow each other, except after front matter.

## Why

Extra blank lines outside code do not change the output. As in markdownlint, the
blank lines right after front matter are not checked.

## Options

Set them under `rules.no-multiple-blank-lines.options`.

- `max_consecutive` (`integer`, default `1`): Most blank lines allowed in a row.
  Values below 1 count as 1\. Also accepted as `maximum`.

## Fix

The fix deletes the extra blank lines. gomdlint reports blank lines inside an
HTML comment without a fix. gomdlint may report a finding without a fix when the
fix would change a line with one character in brackets, such as \[x\] or \[1\],
or the lines around it up to a blank line, because it could add or remove a task
list checkbox. In a document with raw HTML other than comments and plain br,
wbr, hr or img tags, gomdlint reports every finding without a fix.

## Example

This document breaks the rule:

```markdown
# Guide

Install the tool.


Run it in the project root.
```

gomdlint reports:

```text
5:1 Multiple consecutive blank lines (found 2, max 1)
```

The fix changes it to:

```markdown
# Guide

Install the tool.

Run it in the project root.
```

## Configure

```yaml
rules:
  no-multiple-blank-lines:
    options:
      max_consecutive: 1
```

Under `rules`, `no-multiple-blank-lines: false` turns the rule off and
`no-multiple-blank-lines: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable no-multiple-blank-lines` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line no-multiple-blanks -->
```
